# crunch / crnlib: Crunch texture compression (zlib license, see license.txt and README.md)
file(GLOB CRNLIB_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/crnlib/*.cpp)
if(WIN32)
    list(FILTER CRNLIB_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "crn_threading_pthreads\\.cpp$")
else()
    list(FILTER CRNLIB_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "crn_threading_win32\\.cpp$")
endif()
add_library(crnlib STATIC ${CRNLIB_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(crnlib PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/inc PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/crnlib)
set_target_properties(crnlib PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CXX_STANDARD 17)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(crnlib PRIVATE /w)
else()
    target_compile_options(crnlib PRIVATE -w -fno-strict-aliasing)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(crnlib PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
endif()
